description: memory.md states, separately and per-setting, that three unrelated setting groups (warmup_min_items_threshold/warmup_min_memory_threshold, mem_high_wat/mem_low_wat, and exp_pager_stime) are no longer supported through cbepctl and are now configured via the REST API. Three independent instances on one page is a cluster-wide migration away from cbepctl stated three times as a local footnote and nowhere as an architectural change. An operator with cbepctl in their scripts has no single page telling them the tool's configuration surface has been retired.
